exact_rubric: היום ראשון בשבת שבו הלויים היו אומרים במקדש
uncertainties: Levites word: after ה–ל–ו I see two short yods before the final mem (ה ל ו י י ם). The word is about as wide as six letters, while the three-letter שבו next to it is about half that width, which fits two yods. Without zooming I can't fully rule out that one 'yod' is really a stroke of the vav or the mem, so a magnified crop of that word is worth checking.

Marginal label (left margin, ending with a period): this is a guess from context. 'Sunday' in Judeo-German would be זונטאג, and the shapes may fit that, but at this resolution I can't confidently tell zayin from vav or nun from tet. I've left the pointing out completely because I can't read it reliably.
The line below (כד לדוד מזמור…) is Psalm 24 and is not part of the rubric, so I left it out.
